observed_mismatch: The accepted RPC matrix requires typed model/capability/candidate/job Host calls, but the public SDK exposes no equivalent model, Broker, typed Candidate-stage or Job-completion ports. Its legacy CoreAuthorityPort.stage_candidate(operation_key,bundle_id) omits result_bundle_asset_id and input_snapshot_hash. RunSnapshot also represents Prompt only indirectly as a Skill release and has no independent Prompt binding.
stopped_scope: live model invocation and response decoding
live Prompt/Skill execution through Host composition
Host Asset creation and candidate staging
durable Job completion and receipt transaction
installable manifest, worker and runtime composition
independently_delivered_scope: SDK-verified candidate-batch/v1 materialization from Host-created Asset IDs
proposed_v2_or_adr: P0 should publish typed SDK ports matching host.model.invoke/v1, host.capability.invoke|poll|cancel/v1, host.candidate.stage/v1 and host.job.complete/v1. P0/P2 should also decide whether Prompt remains a designated Skill release or receives an explicit RunSnapshot binding. P5 will add effectful composition only after those surfaces and NW-P2-PROMPT-SKILL-RUNTIME-02 are accepted.
